episodes.text: ATLAS is the mind of the Travelers Clan.
ATLAS is a learning agent that remembers what it is taught.
ATLAS has episodic memory for experiences.
ATLAS has semantic memory for facts.
ATLAS has procedural memory for skills.
Sleep is the process where ATLAS consolidates memories into facts.
Evolution is the process where ATLAS tunes its own learning parameters.
The chief is the person who teaches ATLAS.
The chief is the founder of the Travelers Clan.
Feedback is the signal that tells ATLAS whether an answer was good.
Dopamine is the reward signal inside ATLAS.
A correction is a message that starts with no or actually and fixes a wrong fact.
Travelers Clan is a travel company.
Travelers Clan offers group trips for travelers.
Travelers Clan offers customised itineraries.
Travelers Clan is run by the chief.
A lead is a person who has shown interest in a trip.
A booking is a confirmed trip with a paid advance.
A junk lead is a lead with no budget or no intent to travel.
A real lead is a lead with a date, a destination and a budget.
WhatsApp is the main channel for talking to leads.
Meta ads is the main channel for finding new leads.
Cost per booking is the key metric for ads.
A follow-up is a message sent to a lead who has not replied.
Ghosting is when a lead stops replying.
The first reply to a lead should go out within ten minutes.
An itinerary is a day by day plan of a trip.
A package price has transport, stay, food and activities.
The advance is the part of the price paid to confirm a booking.
Cancellation policy is the rule for refunds when a traveler drops out.
Peak season is the time when demand and prices are highest.
Off season is the time when demand and prices are lowest.
Group size is the number of travelers on a trip.
A trip leader is the clan member who guides a group trip.
A lead is a person who messaged about a trip.
A hot lead is a lead with a travel date, a destination, a budget and a group size.
A warm lead is a lead with intent but missing a date or a budget.
A cold lead is a lead who only asked the price.
A junk lead is a lead with no intent to travel.
The first reply should go out within ten minutes.
A fast first reply doubles the chance of a booking.
The first reply should ask for the travel date, the group size and the budget.
A qualifying question is a question that reveals date, budget or group size.
Price should be shared only after the dates and group size are known.
A lead who asks only for the price needs a qualifying question first.
A follow-up is a message to a lead who went quiet.
The first follow-up should go out after 24 hours.
The second follow-up should go out after 3 days.
The third follow-up should offer a new angle such as a group discount or a date change.
Ghosting is when a lead stops replying after the price.
Ghosting usually means the price felt high or the plan felt vague.
A voice note builds more trust than a long text.
A short itinerary PDF increases replies.
Social proof is photos and reviews from past trips.
Social proof should be sent before the price.
An advance is the payment that confirms a booking.
The advance should be collected on the same day the lead says yes.
A payment link reduces drop-off at the advance step.
A cancellation-proof offer is a flexible date change instead of a refund.
A WhatsApp broadcast should go to past travelers before a new trip opens.
Past travelers are the cheapest source of new bookings.
A referral is a booking that came from a past traveler.
Referrals should be rewarded with a discount on the next trip.
Conversion rate is bookings divided by leads.
A good conversion rate for group trips is five to ten percent.
Meta ads is the main channel for finding new leads.
Cost per lead is ad spend divided by leads.
Cost per booking is ad spend divided by bookings.
Cost per booking is the metric that matters most.
A cheap lead that never books is wasted spend.
Junk leads usually come from broad audiences and vague creatives.
A clear price range in the ad filters out junk leads.
A clear date in the ad filters out junk leads.
The best creative is a real video from a past trip.
Reels outperform static images for travel.
The hook is the first three seconds of a video.
An ad should be refreshed every two weeks to avoid fatigue.
Ad fatigue is when frequency rises and results fall.
Frequency above three means the audience is tired.
Lookalike audiences built from past bookers perform best.
Retargeting should target people who messaged but did not book.
A lead form ad should ask the travel date and budget.
Click to WhatsApp ads give faster conversations than lead forms.
The budget should move toward the ad set with the lowest cost per booking.
An ad set should get at least three days before judging it.
The landing message should answer the ad promise within one reply.
Peak season ads should start six weeks before the trip.
Off season ads should sell early-bird prices.
An itinerary is a day by day plan of a trip.
A package price includes transport, stay, food and activities.
A package price excludes flights unless stated.
The advance is usually twenty to thirty percent of the package price.
The balance is due before departure.
Group size for a group trip is usually twelve to twenty travelers.
A trip leader is the clan member who guides a group trip.
A trip leader should share a WhatsApp group one week before departure.
A packing list should be shared one week before departure.
Travel insurance should be recommended for every trip.
A buffer day protects the plan from delays.
Peak season is when demand and prices are highest.
Off season is when demand and prices are lowest.
Ladakh season is June to September.
Spiti season is June to October.
Goa season is November to February.
Kerala season is October to March.
Manali is good in both summer and winter.
Rajasthan season is October to March.
Meghalaya season is October to May.
Monsoon is the off season for most mountain trips.
A review request should go out two days after the trip ends.
Photos from the trip should be posted within one week.
A customised itinerary is a trip planned for one private group.
A fixed departure is a group trip on a fixed date open to anyone.
